about: The final merch set for print: the RiskMandate T-shirts, hoodies and business cards of the seven going to Web Summit 2026, proposed by designer@web-summit.dinis on 2 November 2026, restyled on 3 November to the poster style of the print order's example picture (Dinis's choice), with Silvio's line 'Your AI has access. Does it have permission?' for Dinis to sign off item by item. RiskMandate only (Dinis, 2 November 2026): no sponsor, no other brand, no Web Summit name or logo on anything printed. The print files are made from this file and data/design.json by team/designer/print/make-print.py and published at /print/ for the printers. Sign-off: set signed_off to {"by": "dinis", "at": "<ISO time>"} on each item (Dinis, or his agent on his word).
rules: RiskMandate only: no sponsor logo, no other brand, no Web Summit name or logo, on any garment or card (Dinis, 2 November 2026).
Every back and every card carries the wearer's own QR code, to https://web-summit.sgit.ai/meet/<id>/, black on a white panel with its quiet zone.

tee.blank: TH Clothes Ankara, 190 g, 100% cotton (the printer's blank, from 3 November); hoodies TH Clothes
tee.method: DTF or DTG, full colour (seven small runs, so no screen printing)

chest.where: left chest (wearer's left), top 180 mm below the shoulder seam

card.stock: 350 g/m2 or heavier, matt, both sides printed, square corners

people.note: The example said 'I brought 6 agents to Web Summit': nothing but RiskMandate goes on the merch, so it ends 'Ask me why.', as on Jose's card.

people.stock_colour: no true purple in Ankara: lavanda or bordô, for Dinis or Vicky to choose

hoodie.said: I approve my print set, the hoodie and the card

card.said: I approve my print set, the hoodie and the card

sizes: Each person's sizes (3 T-shirts and a hoodie) are still to collect: Vicky and Silvio, from the seven, before the order (WS-48).
style: The print order's example picture (assets/print/riskmandate-pedido-tshirts.jpg), chosen by Dinis on 3 November 2026: the line in condensed capitals (Barlow Condensed Bold), a short divider, the wordmark RISK (light) MANDATE (bold), and a tagline per shirt; the back has the wordmark, 'Agents with a Mandate', the QR and 'Meet me / Book a meeting / Talk to my agent'.
stock_colours_source: The nearest TH Clothes Ankara colours, from the print order (content/print-order.md, procurement@web-summit.silvio), after the order moved to the second printer (3 November): to confirm on the printer's colour charts, which Silvio has.
